heroes.name: D.Mon
heroes.summary: Reductions in armor and melee damage are offset by faster utility deployment, shifting focus toward reactive play over raw brawling.

changes.note: Armor reduced from 325 to 300. (6v6)
Damage reduced from 65 to 60.
Cast time decreased from 0.065s to 0.016s.
Notches on side of shield reduced in size.
Transformation duration has been reduced from 1.95 to 0.95 seconds.
A new first-person bootup animation lasting 1 second has been added.
Spread reduced from 2 to 1.75 degrees.
Minimum falloff range reduced from 30 to 20 meters.

heroes.name: D.Va
heroes.summary: Increased mech health improves frontline presence, though the slower ultimate charge rate limits Self-Destruct frequency.

changes.note: Mech base health increased from 175 to 200. (5v5)
Ultimate Charge cost reduction increased to 60% (Up from 50%).

heroes.name: Domina
heroes.summary: A straightforward buff to ultimate frequency allows for more consistent pressure throughout the match.

changes.note: Ultimate Cost reduced by 6%.

heroes.name: Mauga
heroes.summary: Heavy nerfs to dual-chaingun spread and falloff significantly weaken his close-range lethality and sustain.

changes.note: Base armor reduced from 150 to 125.
Maximum spread when firing a single gun reverted from 1.5 to 1 degree.
Maximum spread when firing both guns increased from 4 to 5 degrees.
Damage falloff minimum range when firing both guns reduced from 15 to 10 meters.

heroes.name: Winston
heroes.summary: Decreasing the barrier cooldown improves engagement frequency, making him more mobile despite the reduced shield duration.

changes.note: Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds. (5v5)
Duration reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

heroes.name: wrecking Ball
heroes.summary: Reducing the duration of key ability windows limits his capacity for disruption and survivability in deep dives.

changes.note: Duration reduced from 1.5 to 1 second.

heroes.name: Zarya
heroes.summary: An increased cooldown on Particle Barrier reduces her energy generation potential and increases vulnerability windows.

changes.note: Cooldown increased from 11 to 12 seconds. (5v5)

heroes.name: Anran
heroes.summary: Faster revival casting significantly increases the reliability of their ultimate during high-pressure team fights.

changes.note: Reduced the amount of visual effects enemies see when impacted by Dancing Blaze.
Cast time reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds.

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.summary: Broad damage reductions across her kit significantly lower her burst potential and overall lethality.

changes.note: Refunded automatic bolts reduced from 8 to 5.
Damage reduced from 30 to 28.
Explosive Bolt explosion damage reduced from 80 to 75.
Explosive bolt impact sound effects reduced.

heroes.name: Junkrat
heroes.summary: Trading mobility speed for more frequent Concussion Mines shifts his power toward area denial and displacement.

changes.note: Bonus speed reduced from 125% to 100%.
Cooldown reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

heroes.name: Sierra
heroes.summary: Increased projectile speed improves long-range consistency, while reduced damage and cooldowns move her toward a utility harasser role.

changes.note: Weapon projectile speed increased from 90 to 120.
Damage reduced from 9 to 8.5.
Damage reduced from 9 to 8.5.
Cooldown reduced from 8.5 to 7 seconds.

heroes.name: Symmetra
heroes.summary: Significant nerfs to Teleporter range and reuse speed drastically reduce her team's mobility and setup efficiency.

changes.note: Placement range reduced from 30 to 25 meters.
Teleport reuse cooldown increased from 1 to 1.25 seconds.

heroes.name: Torbjörn
heroes.summary: Reduced turret placement flexibility is countered by improved consistency in close-quarters shotgun combat.

changes.note: Deploy turrets increased throw range reduced from 50% to 25%.
Secondary fire spread reduced from 4.5 to 4 degrees.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: Faster melee combos are tempered by increased ability recoveries and reduced sustain, rewarding precise execution over ability spam.

changes.note: Initial Swing delay reduced from 0.3 to 0.15 seconds.
Horizontal swing duration reduced from 0.25 to 0.2 seconds.
Combo link duration increased from 0.75 to 0.9 seconds.
Recovery increased from 0.5 to 0.75 seconds.
Recovery increased from 0.2 to 0.5 seconds.
Camera pitch is no longer fully locked during the slash.
Lifesteal per stack reduced to 4% (Down from 5%).

heroes.name: Baptiste
heroes.summary: Comprehensive buffs to Immortality Field make it more frequent and harder for enemies to destroy.

changes.note: Unkillable health threshold increased from 20% to 25%.
Cooldown reduced from 22 to 20 seconds.
Health increased from 125 to 150.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.summary: Swapping base health for armor improves her resilience against chip damage while maintaining the same total HP pool.

changes.note: Health reduced from 200 to 175.
Armor increased from 50 to 75.

heroes.name: Jetpack Cat
heroes.summary: Heavy-handed nerfs to throughput and utility reliability significantly lower their effectiveness as a primary support.

changes.note: Increased sound priority and volume of base movement and Frenetic Flight.
Damage and healing per projectile reduced from 4.5 to 4.
Stuns and mobility locking effects on a carried target now disconnect Lifeline.
Allies now automatically accept Lifeline when over a death plane.
Damage reduced to 20% of healing (Down from 30%).

heroes.name: Kiriko
heroes.summary: Reductions in projectile speed and Suzu's protective window demand much higher precision and better positioning.

changes.note: Projectile travel speed reduced from 24 to 18 meters per second.
Maximum seeking range reduced from 35 to 30 meters.
Phased out invulnerability duration reduced from 0.65 to 0.5 seconds.
Explosion radius reduced from 5 to 4 meters.

heroes.name: Wuyang
heroes.summary: Increased healing throughput is balanced by a stricter line-of-sight requirement, encouraging tighter team positioning.

changes.note: Regeneration rate increased from 12.5% to 15% per second.
Line of sight timeout reduced from 5 to 3 seconds.

heroes.name: Zenyatta
heroes.summary: A reduced line-of-sight window for Harmony Orb forces Zenyatta to maintain more dangerous positioning to sustain allies.

changes.note: Line of sight timeout reduced from 5 to 3 seconds.

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.summary: Lower return damage on her blade reduces her overall execution potential and self-healing during close-range brawls.

changes.note: Return damage reduced to 30 (Down from 40).

heroes.name: Genji
heroes.summary: Enhanced cooldown resets reward aggressive play and significantly improve his ability to chain eliminations.

changes.note: Cooldown reduction per target increased to 2.5s (Up from 2s).

heroes.name: Ana
heroes.summary: Faster Nano Boost attack speeds provide higher offensive utility, offset by a much slower ultimate generation rate.

changes.note: Attack speed bonus increased to 50% (Up from 30%).
Ultimate Charge gain reduced to 10% (Down from 25%).
